## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also describe relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`pnpm run lint` passes without errors).
- [ ] I have formatted my code with Prettier (`pnpm run format:check` passes).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed (`pnpm test`).
- [ ] My changes do NOT introduce dependencies outside the NVIDIA NIM ecosystem.
- [ ] I have updated documentation or README where applicable.
